items: Headquarters of all 18 Railway Zones are frequently asked in RRB NTPC and Group D exams.
Note the date of India's first electric train: February 3, 1925 (between Bombay VT and Kurla Harbour).
Differentiate clearly between rail gauge dimensions: Broad Gauge (1.676 m), Meter Gauge (1.000 m), and Narrow Gauge (0.762 m / 0.610 m).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Indian Railways is organized into 18 zones, with South Coast Railway (Visakhapatnam) being the newest zone.
The first passenger train ran on April 16, 1853, between Bombay (Bori Bunder) and Thane.
The Railway Board was constituted in 1905 on the recommendation of the Sir Thomas Robertson Committee.
Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and remains one of the world's largest rail networks.
